alt: Salesforce Tower, the 61-storey tapering glass skyscraper and tallest building in San Francisco, photographed from street level against a blue sky — the headquarters of the company whose global platform collapsed during its own AI conference
story: On September 16, 2026 — Day 2 of Dreamforce, Salesforce's flagship conference with 40,000 in-person attendees — the company's entire global CRM platform went down due to a legacy login server buckling under load, locking customers out worldwide while executives were on stage unveiling AIforce and Claudeforce AI products.
why_funny: A company charging enterprise rates for AI-powered cloud reliability crashed its own flagship event because nobody had upgraded the login server — The Register noted Salesforce's $400 million annual AI budget had apparently 'gone somewhere other than their login server.'
